Max HP = HP x {MON_HP_PER_POINT}. HP-scaled skills use max HP.
Physical power. Basic attack = {BASIC_ATTACK_POWER} x STR (or INT, if higher). STR skills deal physical damage.
Magic power. INT skills deal magical damage. The basic attack uses INT if it beats STR.
Magic defence. {MON_DEF_K} WIS halves magical damage taken. Also powers WIS heals and shields.

Dodge and precision. Evade chance: {MON_EVADE_BASE:pct}, +{MON_EVADE_PER_DEX:pct} per DEX above the attacker's (less if below), max {MON_EVADE_CAP:pct}. Spells are grazed instead ({MON_GRAZE_MULT:pct} damage, no crit). DEX also makes its own hits harder to dodge and adds {MON_CRIT_DMG_PER_DEX:pct} crit damage per point.

Physical defence. {MON_DEF_K} DEF halves physical damage taken.
Turn speed. SPD {SPD_REF} acts once per turn; double SPD acts twice as often.

Crits and fortune. Crit chance: {MON_CRIT_BASE:pct} + {MON_CRIT_PER_LUK:pct} per LUK, max {MON_CRIT_CAP:pct}. Crits deal x{MON_CRIT_DMG} (more with DEX). Fortune (max {MON_FORTUNE_CAP:pct}) gives a chance to reroll a failed dodge or crit, and to make an enemy crit on it roll again.
Physical: can be dodged. DEF reduces it.
Magical: can't be dodged, only grazed. WIS reduces it.
Deals damage and can crit. x{ELEMENT_STRONG_MULT} if its element is strong vs the target, x{ELEMENT_WEAK_MULT} if weak. Defence reduces it; shields absorb it first.

The unit loses {ENTROPY_STUN_GAUGE} action gauge and acts later.
Every enemy deals {ENTROPY_ENRAGE_FRAC:pct} more damage for {ENTROPY_ENRAGE_TURNS} turns.

{MON_RESENT_FRAC:pct} of the HP damage enemies deal it fills a red pool that adds to its STR. Each of its own actions drains {MON_RESENT_DECAY:pct} of the pool.

Below {MON_VANTAGE_HP:pct} HP, it strikes first: an enemy aiming a single-target attack at it takes a basic attack before it lands, once per enemy action. If that knocks the attacker out, the attack never comes.

Once per fight, a blow that would knock it out leaves it at 1 HP, on Death's Door. There, each blow that would knock it out is survived at 1 HP with a {MON_DOOR_START:pct} chance, {MON_DOOR_STEP:pct} lower for each blow it already survived.

Its shields never run out and stack, up to {MON_BARRICADE_CAP:pct} of its max HP. Overheal that turns into shield (Living Ocean, Abyssal Bloom) also fills up to that cap.
Starts each fight with a ward of {MON_WARD_WIS} times its WIS. The ward takes {MON_WARD_SHARE:pct} of each blow's HP damage first. While the ward holds, its cooldowns run {MON_WARD_CDR:pct} faster.

When its turn comes at full HP or with a shield, holding under {MON_BRAVE_MAX} pips, it Defaults: no action, +1 pip and {MON_BRAVE_GUARD:pct} less hit damage until its next turn. Otherwise it acts, then spends each pip on an extra action in a row (at most {MON_EXTRA_ACTIONS_CAP} per turn; the rest wait).
A crit, or a hit whose element is strong against the target, refunds {MON_ONE_MORE:pct} of its turn gauge, once per action, never past a full gauge.

Each enemy has {MON_BREAK_PIPS} guard pips. Its crits and its hits whose element is strong against the enemy strip one. At 0 the enemy breaks: it loses its next action and takes +{MON_BREAK_BONUS:pct} hit damage until it acts again, then its pips refill.
After its {MON_LATENT_ACTIONS}th action of a fight, all its stats but HP rise by {MON_LATENT_BONUS:pct} for the rest of the fight.

If it starts a fight alone on its side, all its stats rise by {MON_LONE_BONUS:pct} for the fight. With allies, they fall by {MON_LONE_MALUS:pct} instead. Strong in run fights and the gauntlet, weak in a team.

Once per fight, the first enemy it knocks out rises on its side with {MON_ARISE_STATS:pct} of its stats and its skills, but none of its rules. Not the last enemy: the fight is over then. Does nothing in a one-on-one fight.

When it is knocked out, its living allies split {MON_RITE_SHARE:pct} of its base stats among them for the rest of the fight. A save from Rebirth or Death's Door is not a knockout. Does nothing in a one-on-one fight.
each ally gains {amount:pct} of its stats
It also gets the capstone of the tree in the slot just before this one, bought or not, while that tree stays there. Nothing in the first slot; chase and fusion capstones are never copied.
Keepsake growth nodes grow twice as fast: +{KEEPSAKE_STEP} growth per {KEEPSAKE_DRILLS} drills of their stat becomes twice that, still up to +{KEEPSAKE_MAX}.

A slotted tree with its capstone bought that wins {MASTERY_WINS} rank fights while this is held becomes mastered: if it is overwritten, its capstone stays in the kit (last) while this is held. Chase and fusion trees, and Mastery itself, are never mastered.
This tree's own stat can rise past the usual cap, up to {LIMIT_BREAK_MAX}, by drills and flat nodes.

Each hit it lands fills the target's bleed gauge by {MON_BLEED_PER_HIT} per {MON_BLEED_DEX_REF} DEX. A full gauge (100) bursts for {MON_BLEED_BURST:pct} of the target's max HP as true damage, then empties. Answers high-HP bosses.
Its hits deal +{MON_PRIV_BONUS:pct} damage to a target with at least {MON_PRIV_DEBUFFS} active debuffs from any source (stacked copies count). Corruption casts a debuff twice.

Each hit marks the target with the hit's element. Its next hit on that target of a different element deals +{MON_EQ_BONUS:pct} damage and clears the mark. Elemental Avatar makes every hit one element.
Each active skill it uses is cast twice at once (the second at full power), then is locked for the rest of the fight. Pairs with Dead Branch: each lock draws a new skill.
Whenever one of its skills is locked for the fight, it gains a random active skill it lacks for the rest of the fight. Corruption locks every skill it uses.

Each rank-fight win adds {DEVOUR_FRAC:pct} of the opponent's highest stat to the same stat. Each new cycle costs {DEVOUR_ENERGY} energy.
A Super drill refunds its energy cost. A drill made below {BREATH_SAFE} energy cannot injure, and cannot Super.
